decisions.choice: the days drew near to die: his death was close
decisions.reason: "His days drew near to die" is a way of saying that someone's death is near, used of Jacob (Genesis 47:29) and of Moses (Deuteronomy 31:14).

decisions.choice: charged: gave his last instructions
decisions.reason: The verb means to give orders. Here, as when Jacob finished charging his sons before he died (Genesis 49:33), it is a dying man's final charge, something like a spoken will. It covers both David's religious charge (verses 2-4) and his instructions about particular men (verses 5-9).

decisions.choice: When the time came near for David to die; When David was about to die
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the Hebrew picture of days drawing near into a plain statement about time.

decisions.choice: David speaks to Solomon in 해라체
decisions.reason: As the Genesis note for parent and child: a father speaks 해라체 to his son, even a son who is now king.

decisions.choice: os dias de Davi se aproximaram para morrer
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom (m1) in the words of Genesis 47:29 in Portuguese, where Jacob's days drew near to die, so that the dying charge of the father to the son can be heard in both places (m2).

source.text: אָנֹכִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחָזַקְתָּ֖ וְהָיִ֥יתָֽ לְאִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: I [am] going in [the] way of all the earth; and you shall be strong and shall become a man,

en.L: "I [am] going in the way of all the earth; so be strong and become a man.
en.B: "I am going the way of all the earth. Be strong, then, and show yourself a man.
en.R: "I am about to die, as everyone on earth must. So be strong, and show that you are a man.

es.L: «Yo [voy] por el camino de toda la tierra; esfuérzate, pues, y sé hombre.
es.B: «Yo me voy por el camino de toda la tierra. Sé fuerte, pues, y pórtate como un hombre.
es.R: «Estoy a punto de morir, como todos en la tierra tienen que morir. Así que sé fuerte y demuestra que eres un hombre.

fr.L: « Moi, je m’en vais par le chemin de toute la terre ; et tu seras fort, et tu deviendras un homme.
fr.B: « Je m’en vais par le chemin de toute la terre. Sois donc fort et montre-toi un homme.
fr.R: « Je vais bientôt mourir, comme tout le monde sur la terre. Alors sois fort, et montre que tu es un homme.

sw.L: "Mimi [ninaenda] katika njia ya dunia yote; basi uwe hodari, uwe mwanamume.
sw.B: "Mimi ninaenda njia ya dunia yote. Basi uwe hodari, ujionyeshe kuwa mwanamume.
sw.R: "Mimi niko karibu kufa, kama kila mtu duniani anavyopaswa kufa. Basi uwe hodari, uonyeshe kwamba wewe ni mwanamume.

vi.L: "Cha [đang] đi trên con đường của cả thế gian; vậy con hãy mạnh mẽ và hãy nên người đàn ông.
vi.B: "Cha sắp đi con đường mà mọi người trên đất đều phải đi. Vậy con hãy mạnh mẽ và tỏ ra mình là đấng nam nhi.
vi.R: "Cha sắp qua đời, như mọi người trên đất đều phải chết. Vậy con hãy mạnh mẽ, hãy tỏ ra mình là người đàn ông can đảm.

ko.L: "나는 온 땅의 길로 가고 있다. 그러니 너는 강해져서 남자가 되어라.
ko.B: "나는 이제 온 세상 사람이 가는 길로 간다. 그러니 너는 굳세어라. 대장부답게 처신하여라.
ko.R: "나는 이제 곧 죽는다. 세상 모든 사람이 다 그렇게 죽는다. 그러니 너는 굳세어라. 사내답게 행동하여라.

pt.L: "Eu vou pelo caminho de toda a terra. Sê forte e porta-te como homem.
pt.B: "Estou para seguir o caminho de toda a terra. Sê forte e porta-te como homem.
pt.R: "Estou para morrer, como todos na terra precisam morrer. Sê forte e porta-te como homem.

decisions.choice: going in the way of all the earth: about to die
decisions.reason: The same words are Joshua's at the end of his life (Joshua 23:14). Death is the road that everyone on earth walks.

decisions.choice: become a man: act with a man's courage and steadiness
decisions.reason: "Be a man" calls for courage and firmness, as when the Philistines urged each other, "Be men and fight" (1 Samuel 4:9). Solomon was young (3:7), and the hard tasks of verses 5-9 lay ahead of him. The phrase is about maturity and nerve, not about age or strength of body.

decisions.choice: you shall be strong and become: commands
decisions.reason: The verbs are in a form that, after David's statement, carries the force of a command: in view of his coming death, Solomon must be strong.

decisions.choice: show yourself a man
decisions.reason: Balanced says "show yourself a man" so that the phrase is heard as a call to act, not as a statement about becoming an adult.

decisions.choice: I am about to die, as everyone on earth must
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom in plain words.

decisions.choice: "Estoy a punto de morir, como todos en la tierra tienen que morir"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable (r-en-2): Readable says what "the way of all the earth" means; Literal and Balanced keep the picture.

decisions.choice: David says "cha" and "con" to Solomon
decisions.reason: A father's last charge to his son; the Genesis note's forms between parent and child, not the king's "ta" and "ngươi".

decisions.choice: Sê forte e porta-te como homem (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: David's charge (m2, m3) is worded as a set phrase at every level. "Sê forte" is the opening of the charge to Joshua, "Sê forte e corajoso" (Joshua 1:6, 7, 9 in Portuguese), which verse 3 goes on to echo ("para que ajas sabiamente", Joshua 1:7); "porta-te como homem" is the call to courage and steadiness that the Philistines give each other in 1 Samuel 4:9 ("ajam como homens" in Portuguese), not a statement about growing up, as the English Balanced says "show yourself a man".

decisions.choice: tu (David's charge to Solomon, verses 2-9)
decisions.reason: David speaks his dying charge to Solomon (verses 2-9) with "tu", where a father elsewhere says "você" to his son: the charge takes up the words of the LORD's charge to Joshua and Moses' to Israel, which Portuguese gives with "tu" (Joshua 1:6-9; Deuteronomy 17:18-20; m3 on verse 3), and the solemn second person keeps it a testament rather than a conversation. The oath he quotes to Shimei (verse 8) keeps the "você" of 2 Samuel 19:24.

decisions.choice: o caminho de toda a terra (L, B); como todos na terra precisam morrer (R)
decisions.reason: Joshua's words at the end of his life (m1) keep the Portuguese of Joshua 23:14 at each level.

records.literal_gloss: and keep [the] charge of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments and his judgments and his testimonies, as [is] written in [the] law of Moses, so that you may act wisely [in] all that you do and [in] all where you turn there,

en.L: And keep the charge of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, to walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, to keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies, as [it is] written in the law of Moses, so that you may act wisely in all that you do and everywhere that you turn,
en.B: Keep what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has entrusted to you: walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways and keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rulings, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decrees, as they are written in the law of Moses. Then you will act wisely and succeed in all you do and wherever you turn,
en.R: Do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given you to do. Live the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants you to live, and obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws, commands, rules, and instructions, as they are written in the teaching of Moses. Then you will be wise and do well in everything you do and wherever you go.

es.L: Y guarda el encargo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, andando en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos, guardando {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decretos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} testimonios, como [está] escrito en la ley de Moisés, para que prosperes en todo lo que hagas y dondequiera que te vuelvas,
es.B: Cumple lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha encomendado: anda en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos y guarda {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} preceptos, como están escritos en la ley de Moisés. Así actuarás con sabiduría y tendrás éxito en todo lo que hagas y dondequiera que vayas,
es.R: Haz lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha encargado. Vive como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere que vivas, y obedece {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} normas y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} instrucciones, como están escritos en la enseñanza de Moisés. Así serás sabio y te irá bien en todo lo que hagas y dondequiera que vayas.

fr.L: Et garde l’observance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, pour marcher dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins, pour garder {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages, comme [il est] écrit dans la loi de Moïse, afin que tu agisses avec sagesse dans tout ce que tu feras et partout où tu te tourneras,
fr.B: Garde ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a confié : marche dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins et garde {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} règles et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décrets, comme ils sont écrits dans la loi de Moïse. Alors tu agiras avec sagesse et tu réussiras dans tout ce que tu feras et partout où tu te tourneras,
fr.R: Fais ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a donné à faire. Vis comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut que tu vives, et obéis à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois, à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} règles et à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} instructions, comme ils sont écrits dans l’enseignement de Moïse. Alors tu seras sage et tu réussiras dans tout ce que tu feras, partout où tu iras.

sw.L: Ushike agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, kushika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, na shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, kama ilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa, ili upate kutenda kwa hekima katika yote unayoyafanya na kila unakogeukia,
sw.B: Shika yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekukabidhi: enenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, ushike kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na masharti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama yalivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa. Ndipo utatenda kwa hekima na kufanikiwa katika yote unayofanya na popote unapogeukia,
sw.R: Fanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekupa kufanya. Ishi jinsi anavyotaka uishi, na utii sheria, amri, kanuni na maelekezo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama yalivyoandikwa katika mafundisho ya Musa. Ndipo utakuwa na hekima na kufanikiwa katika kila unalofanya na popote unapokwenda.

vi.L: Hãy giữ điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con truyền phải giữ, để bước đi trong các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giữ các luật lệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, các phán quyết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và các chứng ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như [đã] chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, để con được khôn ngoan trong mọi việc con làm và mọi nơi con hướng đến,
vi.B: Hãy giữ những gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con đã giao phó cho con: bước đi trong các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giữ các luật lệ, điều răn, phán quyết và chứng ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như đã chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se. Như vậy con sẽ hành động khôn ngoan và thành công trong mọi việc con làm và bất cứ nơi nào con đến,
vi.R: Hãy làm những gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con đã giao cho con. Hãy sống theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn, và vâng giữ các luật lệ, điều răn, phán quyết và lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như đã chép trong lời dạy của Môi-se. Như vậy con sẽ khôn ngoan và thành công trong mọi việc con làm và bất cứ nơi nào con đi,

ko.L: 그리고 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 지켜, 그분의 길로 걷고, 모세의 율법에 기록된 대로 그분의 규례와 그분의 계명과 그분의 법도와 그분의 증거를 지켜라. 그러면 네가 하는 모든 일과 네가 향하는 모든 곳에서 지혜롭게 행할 것이다.
ko.B: 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네게 맡기신 일을 지켜라. 그분의 길로 걸으며, 모세의 율법에 기록된 대로 그분의 규례와 계명과 법도와 증거의 말씀을 지켜라. 그러면 네가 무엇을 하든지, 어디로 가든지 지혜롭게 행하여 잘될 것이다.
ko.R: 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네게 맡기신 일을 하여라. 그분께서 원하시는 대로 살고, 모세의 가르침에 적힌 대로 그분의 법과 명령과 규칙과 가르침을 지켜라. 그러면 네가 무엇을 하든지, 어디로 가든지 지혜롭게 잘 해낼 것이다.

pt.L: E guarda o encargo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o teu Deus, andando nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos, guardando os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, e as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} ordenanças, e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} testemunhos, como [está] escrito na lei de Moisés, para que ajas sabiamente em tudo o que fizeres e em tudo para onde te voltares,
pt.B: Cumpre o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te confiou: anda nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos e guarda os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} ordenanças e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} decretos, como estão escritos na lei de Moisés. Assim agirás com sabedoria e serás bem-sucedido em tudo o que fizeres e aonde quer que fores,
pt.R: Faz o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te deu para fazer. Vive como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quer que vivas e obedece às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis, mandamentos, regras e instruções, como estão escritos no ensino de Moisés. Assim serás sábio e te sairás bem em tudo o que fizeres e aonde quer que fores.

decisions.choice: keep the charge of Yahweh: carry out the duty Yahweh has entrusted
decisions.reason: The noun names a duty or trust that someone is set to guard (Genesis 26:5; Leviticus 8:35; Deuteronomy 11:1). The verb "keep" and the noun come from the same root: Solomon is to guard what Yahweh has given him to guard.

decisions.choice: statutes, commandments, judgments, testimonies: the whole of Yahweh's covenant requirements
decisions.reason: The four words overlap and together mean everything the covenant asks, as such lists do in Deuteronomy (Deuteronomy 6:1-2; 8:11; 11:1). The testimonies are the covenant terms solemnly declared and witnessed.

decisions.choice: as written in the law of Moses; so that you may act wisely: words from Deuteronomy and Joshua
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy tells the king to keep a written copy of the law and read it all his life (Deuteronomy 17:18-20). The promise that keeping the law brings wise action and success echoes Deuteronomy 29:8 and Yahweh's charge to Joshua (Joshua 1:7-8), who was also told to be strong.

decisions.choice: act wisely: act with insight, and so succeed
decisions.reason: The verb means to have insight and act on it; success follows from it (1 Samuel 18:14-15). Both sides of the word are meant here.

decisions.choice: statutes, commandments, judgments, testimonies / statutes, commandments, rulings, decrees / laws, commands, rules, instructions
decisions.reason: The four terms follow the wording settled for these words across the books from Exodus on, at each level.

decisions.choice: the teaching of Moses
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for the law of Moses, as in Deuteronomy, because the word covers instruction for all of life, not only rules.

decisions.choice: "estatutos, mandamientos, decretos, testimonios" (L); "estatutos, mandamientos, normas, preceptos" (B); "leyes, mandamientos, normas, instrucciones" (R)
decisions.reason: Four words for what God requires, kept as four at every level, as the English does (r-en-1); "estatuto" and "mandamiento" follow the Pentateuch terms list. The possessives "sus" take the deity_pronoun span, as the English "his" does.

decisions.choice: "la enseñanza de Moisés" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable (r-en-2): torah as teaching; Literal and Balanced say "la ley de Moisés".

decisions.choice: prescriptions, commandements, jugements, témoignages (L); prescriptions, commandements, règles, décrets (B); lois, commandements, règles, instructions (R)
decisions.reason: The four terms take the French wording of Deuteronomy at each level (Deuteronomy 6:17, 20).

decisions.choice: l'enseignement de Moïse
decisions.reason: Readable says "enseignement" for the law of Moses, as the English says "teaching", following the Readable French of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: kanuni, amri, hukumu, shuhuda (Literal); kanuni, amri, maamuzi, masharti (Balanced); sheria, amri, kanuni, maelekezo (Readable)
decisions.reason: The four words for God's requirements follow the Swahili of Deuteronomy at each level, so that the charge to Solomon sounds like the law it quotes.

decisions.choice: mafundisho ya Musa
decisions.reason: Readable says "mafundisho" (teaching) for the law of Moses, as the English Readable says "teaching"; Literal and Balanced keep "sheria ya Musa".

decisions.choice: "luật lệ, điều răn, phán quyết, chứng ước" (L, B); "lời dạy" for the last at R
decisions.reason: Four words for the covenant's requirements (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps four distinct words, with "điều răn" as in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "규례, 계명, 법도, 증거" (L, B); "법, 명령, 규칙, 가르침" (R)
decisions.reason: Four words for the covenant's requirements, kept distinct as the English keeps them; Readable uses plain words.

decisions.choice: "모세의 율법" (L, B); "모세의 가르침" (R)
decisions.reason: Here *torah* is the written law of Moses, so Literal and Balanced say 율법; Readable follows the English "teaching" and the Psalms note's 가르침.

decisions.choice: o encargo (L); estatutos, mandamentos, ordenanças, testemunhos (L) / decretos (B); leis, mandamentos, regras, instruções (R); o ensino de Moisés (R)
decisions.reason: The words for Yahweh's requirements (m1, m2) keep the Portuguese of Deuteronomy at each level: "encargo" as Deuteronomy 11:1, "estatutos", "mandamentos" and "ordenanças" as Deuteronomy 6:1, and "testemunhos" (L), "decretos" (B), "instruções" (R) as Deuteronomy 6:17. Readable says "o ensino de Moisés", as Joshua 1:7 does in Portuguese, where the English says "the teaching of Moses".

decisions.choice: ajas sabiamente (L); agirás com sabedoria e serás bem-sucedido (B)
decisions.reason: The promise echoes the LORD's charge to Joshua (m3), so Literal and Balanced keep the words of Joshua 1:7 in Portuguese; Balanced gives both sides of the verb, insight and success (m4), as the English does.

source.text: לְמַעַן֩ יָקִ֨ים יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־דְּבָר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלַי֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֜יךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּ֗ם לָלֶ֤כֶת לְפָנַי֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת בְּכָל־לְבָבָ֖ם וּבְכָל־נַפְשָׁ֑ם לֵאמֹ֕ר לֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מֵעַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: so that may establish Yahweh his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, If keep your sons their way, to walk before me in faithfulness with all their heart and with all their soul, saying, not will be cut off for you a man from on [the] throne of Israel.

en.L: so that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} may establish {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke concerning me, saying, 'If your sons keep their way, to walk before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in faithfulness with all their heart and with all their soul,' saying, 'a man will not be cut off for you from on the throne of Israel.'
en.B: so that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} may keep the promise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made about me: 'If your descendants watch how they live, walking faithfully before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all their heart and all their soul, there will always be a man of your line on the throne of Israel.'
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will keep the promise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made to me. He said, 'Your descendants must be careful to live faithfully for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with all their heart and soul. If they do, one of your family will always sit on Israel's throne.'

es.L: para que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} confirme {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra que habló acerca de mí, diciendo: ‘Si tus hijos guardan su camino, andando delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en verdad con todo su corazón y con toda su alma’, diciendo: ‘no te faltará varón sobre el trono de Israel’.
es.B: para que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cumpla la promesa que hizo acerca de mí: ‘Si tus descendientes cuidan su conducta y andan fielmente delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} con todo su corazón y con toda su alma, siempre habrá un hombre de tu linaje en el trono de Israel’.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cumplirá la promesa que me hizo. Él dijo: ‘Tus descendientes deben tener cuidado de vivir fielmente para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} con todo su corazón y con toda su alma. Si lo hacen, siempre habrá uno de tu familia sentado en el trono de Israel’.

fr.L: afin que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accomplisse {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dite à mon sujet, disant : “Si tes fils gardent leur chemin, pour marcher devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} avec fidélité, de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme”, disant : “il ne te sera pas retranché un homme de dessus le trône d’Israël.”
fr.B: afin que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tienne la promesse qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faite à mon sujet : “Si tes descendants veillent sur leur conduite et marchent fidèlement devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme, il y aura toujours un homme de ta lignée sur le trône d’Israël.”
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tiendra la promesse qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a faite. Il m’a dit : “Tes descendants doivent faire bien attention à vivre avec fidélité pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme. S’ils le font, il y aura toujours quelqu’un de ta famille sur le trône d’Israël.”

sw.L: ili {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alithibitishe neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alilolinena juu yangu, akisema, 'Ikiwa wana wako wataishika njia yao, kwenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa uaminifu kwa moyo wao wote na kwa nafsi yao yote,' akisema, 'hutakosa mtu juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli.'
sw.B: ili {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atimize ahadi aliyoitoa juu yangu: 'Wazao wako wakiwa waangalifu jinsi wanavyoishi, wakienenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa uaminifu kwa moyo wao wote na kwa roho yao yote, daima kutakuwa na mtu wa ukoo wako juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli.'
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatimiza ahadi aliyonipa. Alisema, 'Wazao wako lazima wawe waangalifu kuishi kwa uaminifu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa moyo wao wote na roho yao yote. Wakifanya hivyo, mtu wa jamaa yako ataketi daima juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli.'

vi.L: để {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm vững lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về cha rằng: 'Nếu các con cháu ngươi giữ đường lối mình, bước đi trước mặt Ta trong sự thành tín, hết lòng và hết linh hồn,' {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: 'thì ngươi sẽ không bao giờ thiếu người ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên.'
vi.B: để {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giữ lời hứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về cha: 'Nếu dòng dõi con cẩn thận về nếp sống mình, hết lòng hết linh hồn bước đi trung tín trước mặt Ta, thì dòng dõi con sẽ luôn có người ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên.'
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với cha. Ngài phán: 'Dòng dõi con phải cẩn thận sống trung tín với Ta, hết lòng hết linh hồn. Nếu chúng làm như vậy, thì gia đình con sẽ luôn có người ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên.'

ko.L: 그리하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에 대하여 하신 그분의 말씀, 곧 '만일 네 아들들이 자기 길을 지켜 그들의 온 마음과 그들의 온 영혼으로 신실하게 내 앞에서 걸으면' 하시고, '이스라엘의 왕좌에서 네게 [대를 이을] 사람이 끊어지지 않을 것이다' 하신 말씀을 이루실 것이다.
ko.B: 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에 대하여 하신 약속을 지키실 것이다. 그분께서는 '네 자손이 자기 행실을 삼가서 온 마음과 온 영혼으로 신실하게 내 앞에서 살면, 이스라엘의 왕좌에 오를 사람이 네 집안에서 끊어지지 않을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 하신 약속을 지키실 것이다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다. '네 자손들은 온 마음과 정성을 다해 신실하게 나를 따라 살도록 조심해야 한다. 그렇게 하면 네 집안에서 언제나 이스라엘의 왕이 나올 것이다.'

pt.L: para que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} confirme a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou a meu respeito, dizendo: 'Se os teus filhos guardarem o seu caminho, andando diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} em fidelidade, com todo o seu coração e com toda a sua alma', dizendo: 'não será cortado para ti um homem de sobre o trono de Israel.'
pt.B: para que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} cumpra a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez a meu respeito: 'Se os teus descendentes cuidarem do modo como vivem, andando fielmente diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, de todo o coração e de toda a alma, sempre haverá um homem da tua descendência no trono de Israel.'
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai cumprir a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me fez. Ele disse: 'Os teus descendentes devem tomar cuidado para viver fielmente para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, de todo o coração e de toda a alma. Se fizerem isso, sempre haverá alguém da tua família sentado no trono de Israel.'

decisions.choice: his word about me: the promise of 2 Samuel 7:12-16
decisions.reason: Through Nathan, Yahweh promised David a son who would build a house for his name and a throne that would stand forever (2 Samuel 7:12-16). Here David speaks of the promise with a condition attached, as Psalm 132:12 does and as Yahweh will repeat to Solomon (1 Kings 8:25; 9:4-5). The promise to David's line stands, but each king who sits on the throne must keep faith.

decisions.choice: in faithfulness: with loyal, true conduct
decisions.reason: The word means firmness and reliability, truth lived out. To walk before Yahweh in it is to serve him loyally and honestly (Joshua 24:14; 1 Samuel 12:24).

decisions.choice: a man will not be cut off for you from the throne: your line will always have a king
decisions.reason: The negative idiom means that David's line will never lack a descendant to reign (8:25; 9:5; Jeremiah 33:17).

decisions.choice: saying: the quotation resumes
decisions.reason: After the long condition, the word "saying" is repeated to pick up the quotation again. It does not start a second promise.

decisions.choice: your descendants; there will always be a man of your line
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "descendants" because the sons meant are all David's heirs in later generations, and turn the negative "will not be cut off" into a positive statement.

decisions.choice: Your descendants must be careful ... If they do
decisions.reason: Readable splits the condition into two short sentences.

decisions.choice: "no te faltará varón sobre el trono" (L); "siempre habrá un hombre de tu linaje en el trono" (B); "siempre habrá uno de tu familia sentado en el trono" (R)
decisions.reason: "A man will not be cut off for you" is said as the Spanish idiom "no te faltará varón" at Literal; Balanced and Readable state it positively, as the English does (r-en-1). The deity_pronoun span is on the written "mí", the free pronoun.

decisions.choice: "네게 [대를 이을] 사람"
decisions.reason: Korean needs a word to show what the man is "for you"; Literal supplies it in brackets.

decisions.choice: God calls David "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The rule for God's words in Kings: God speaking to one person who serves him (David, Solomon, Elijah, a prophet) says "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as in Genesis and the Pentateuch; his words to a king he is judging, to Israel as a nation or to the nations stay "ngươi" / "các ngươi". Here God's promise to David, in the forms of 2 Samuel 7, which this verse quotes.

decisions.choice: os teus filhos, para ti (God to David); não será cortado para ti um homem (L)
decisions.reason: God's promise to David (m1) keeps the "tu" with which God speaks to him in 2 Samuel 7:12-16 in Portuguese. Literal keeps the negative idiom "cortar" (m3); Balanced and Readable turn it into a positive statement, as the English does.

source.text: וְגַ֣ם אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁר־עָ֨שָׂה לִ֜י יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה לִשְׁנֵֽי־שָׂרֵ֣י צִבְא֣וֹת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְאַבְנֵ֨ר בֶּן־נֵ֜ר וְלַעֲמָשָׂ֤א בֶן־יֶ֨תֶר֙ וַיַּ֣הַרְגֵ֔ם וַיָּ֥שֶׂם דְּמֵֽי־מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּשָׁלֹ֑ם וַיִּתֵּ֞ן דְּמֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֗ה בַּחֲגֹֽרָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּמָתְנָ֔יו וּֽבְנַעֲל֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And also you know what did to me Joab son of Zeruiah, what he did to [the] two commanders of [the] armies of Israel, to Abner son of Ner and to Amasa son of Jether, and he killed them and put blood of war in peace, and put blood of war on his belt which [was] on his waist and in his sandals which [were] on his feet.

en.L: And you also know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner son of Ner and to Amasa son of Jether: he killed them, and put [the] blood of war in peace, and put [the] blood of war on his belt that [was] around his waist and in his sandals that [were] on his feet.
en.B: You also know how Joab son of Zeruiah treated me, and what he did to the two commanders of Israel's armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, spilling blood in a time of peace as though it were war, and he stained the belt at his waist and the sandals on his feet with that blood of war.
en.R: You also know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me. You know what he did to two commanders of Israel's armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He murdered them when there was no war, as if they were enemies in battle. Their blood was on the belt around his waist and on the sandals on his feet.

es.L: Y también tú sabes lo que me hizo Joab hijo de Sarvia, lo que hizo a los dos jefes de los ejércitos de Israel, a Abner hijo de Ner y a Amasa hijo de Jeter: los mató, y derramó sangre de guerra en [tiempo de] paz, y puso sangre de guerra en el cinturón que [tenía] en su cintura y en las sandalias que [tenía] en sus pies.
es.B: Tú sabes también lo que me hizo Joab hijo de Sarvia, y lo que hizo a los dos jefes de los ejércitos de Israel, Abner hijo de Ner y Amasa hijo de Jeter. Los mató, derramando en tiempo de paz sangre como si fuera de guerra, y manchó con esa sangre de guerra el cinturón de su cintura y las sandalias de sus pies.
es.R: Tú sabes también lo que me hizo Joab hijo de Sarvia. Sabes lo que hizo a dos jefes de los ejércitos de Israel, Abner hijo de Ner y Amasa hijo de Jeter. Los asesinó cuando no había guerra, como si fueran enemigos en batalla. La sangre de ellos quedó en el cinturón de su cintura y en las sandalias de sus pies.

fr.L: Et tu sais aussi ce que m’a fait Joab fils de Tserouya, ce qu’il a fait aux deux chefs des armées d’Israël, à Abner fils de Ner et à Amasa fils de Yéther : il les a tués, et il a mis le sang de la guerre dans la paix, et il a mis le sang de la guerre sur la ceinture qui [était] à ses reins et dans les sandales qui [étaient] à ses pieds.
fr.B: Tu sais aussi comment Joab, fils de Tserouya, m’a traité, et ce qu’il a fait aux deux chefs des armées d’Israël, Abner fils de Ner et Amasa fils de Yéther. Il les a tués, versant en temps de paix le sang comme à la guerre, et il a taché de ce sang de guerre la ceinture qu’il avait à la taille et les sandales qu’il avait aux pieds.
fr.R: Tu sais aussi ce que Joab, le fils de Tserouya, m’a fait. Tu sais ce qu’il a fait à deux chefs des armées d’Israël, Abner, le fils de Ner, et Amasa, le fils de Yéther. Il les a assassinés alors qu’il n’y avait pas de guerre, comme si c’étaient des ennemis au combat. Leur sang était sur la ceinture qu’il portait à la taille et sur les sandales qu’il avait aux pieds.

sw.L: Tena wewe unajua yale Yoabu mwana wa Seruya aliyonitendea, yale aliyowatendea majemadari wawili wa majeshi ya Israeli, Abneri mwana wa Neri na Amasa mwana wa Yetheri: aliwaua, akaimwaga damu ya vita wakati wa amani, akaitia damu ya vita juu ya mshipi wake [uliokuwa] kiunoni mwake na katika viatu vyake [vilivyokuwa] miguuni mwake.
sw.B: Wewe pia unajua jinsi Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alivyonitendea, na yale aliyowatendea wakuu wawili wa majeshi ya Israeli, Abneri mwana wa Neri na Amasa mwana wa Yetheri. Aliwaua, akimwaga damu wakati wa amani kana kwamba ni wakati wa vita, akautia damu hiyo ya vita mshipi wa kiunoni mwake na viatu vya miguuni mwake.
sw.R: Wewe pia unajua yale Yoabu mwana wa Seruya aliyonitendea. Unajua aliyowatendea wakuu wawili wa majeshi ya Israeli, Abneri mwana wa Neri na Amasa mwana wa Yetheri. Aliwaua kwa hila wakati hapakuwa na vita, kana kwamba walikuwa adui vitani. Damu yao ilikuwa juu ya mshipi wa kiunoni mwake na juu ya viatu vya miguuni mwake.

vi.L: Con cũng biết điều Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia đã làm cho cha, điều hắn đã làm cho hai tướng chỉ huy quân đội Y-sơ-ra-ên, là Áp-ne con trai Nê-rơ và A-ma-sa con trai Giê-the: hắn đã giết họ, đổ máu chiến tranh trong thời bình, và lấy máu chiến tranh ấy vấy lên dây thắt lưng quanh hông hắn và đôi dép dưới chân hắn.
vi.B: Con cũng biết Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia đã đối xử với cha thế nào, và hắn đã làm gì với hai tướng chỉ huy quân đội Y-sơ-ra-ên là Áp-ne con trai Nê-rơ và A-ma-sa con trai Giê-the. Hắn đã giết họ, làm đổ máu trong thời bình như thể đang có chiến tranh, và vấy máu chiến tranh ấy lên dây thắt lưng quanh hông và đôi dép dưới chân mình.
vi.R: Con cũng biết Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia đã làm gì cho cha. Con biết hắn đã làm gì với hai vị tướng chỉ huy quân đội Y-sơ-ra-ên là Áp-ne con trai Nê-rơ và A-ma-sa con trai Giê-the. Hắn đã sát hại họ khi không có chiến tranh, như thể họ là kẻ thù ngoài chiến trường. Máu của họ dính trên dây thắt lưng quanh hông hắn và trên đôi dép dưới chân hắn.

ko.L: 그리고 너도 스루야의 아들 요압이 내게 한 일, 곧 그가 이스라엘 군대의 두 사령관, 넬의 아들 아브넬과 예델의 아들 아마사에게 한 일을 알고 있다. 그가 그들을 죽여 평화로울 때에 전쟁의 피를 흘렸고, 전쟁의 피를 자기 허리에 [두른] 띠와 자기 발에 [신은] 신에 묻혔다.
ko.B: 너도 알다시피 스루야의 아들 요압이 나에게 어떻게 했으며, 이스라엘 군대의 두 사령관인 넬의 아들 아브넬과 예델의 아들 아마사에게 무슨 짓을 했느냐? 그는 그들을 죽였다. 평화로운 때에 마치 전쟁 때처럼 피를 흘렸고, 그 전쟁의 피를 허리에 두른 띠와 발에 신은 신에 묻혔다.
ko.R: 너도 스루야의 아들 요압이 나에게 한 짓을 알고 있다. 그가 이스라엘 군대의 두 사령관, 넬의 아들 아브넬과 예델의 아들 아마사에게 한 짓도 알고 있다. 그는 전쟁도 없는데 마치 싸움터의 원수인 것처럼 그들을 죽였다. 그들의 피가 그의 허리띠와 신발에 묻었다.

pt.L: E também tu sabes o que me fez Joabe, filho de Zeruia, o que ele fez aos dois comandantes dos exércitos de Israel, a Abner, filho de Ner, e a Amasa, filho de Jéter: ele os matou, e pôs [o] sangue da guerra na paz, e pôs [o] sangue da guerra no cinto que [estava] na sua cintura e nas sandálias que [estavam] nos seus pés.
pt.B: Tu também sabes o que Joabe, filho de Zeruia, me fez, e o que fez aos dois comandantes dos exércitos de Israel, Abner, filho de Ner, e Amasa, filho de Jéter. Ele os matou, derramando sangue em tempo de paz como se estivesse em guerra, e manchou com esse sangue de guerra o cinto que tinha na cintura e as sandálias que tinha nos pés.
pt.R: Tu também sabes o que Joabe, filho de Zeruia, me fez. Sabes o que ele fez a dois comandantes dos exércitos de Israel, Abner, filho de Ner, e Amasa, filho de Jéter. Ele os assassinou quando não havia guerra, como se fossem inimigos numa batalha. O sangue deles ficou no cinto que ele usava na cintura e nas sandálias dos seus pés.

decisions.choice: Abner and Amasa: Joab's two murders
decisions.reason: Joab killed Abner, Saul's former commander, after David had made peace with him (2 Samuel 3:22-30), and he killed Amasa, whom David had made commander of the army (2 Samuel 19:14; 20:8-10). Both men were killed in peacetime by a man pretending friendship.

decisions.choice: what Joab did to me: the two murders
alternatives: other wrongs as well, such as killing Absalom
decisions.reason: The second "what he did" spells out the first: by killing these men Joab wronged David, who had given them his word and was blamed for their deaths (2 Samuel 3:28-39). Joab's killing of Absalom against David's orders (2 Samuel 18:5, 14) may also be in mind, but the verse names only the two murders.

decisions.choice: put blood of war in peace: shed in peacetime the blood that belongs only to battle
decisions.reason: Killing in war was not murder, but Joab killed these men when there was no war. He treated a time of peace as a battlefield, so the killings were murder.

decisions.choice: blood of war on his belt and sandals: the guilt marked him
decisions.reason: Joab stabbed Amasa with a sword that slipped from his belt (2 Samuel 20:8-10), so the blood was on him in a plain sense. The picture also says that the guilt clings to Joab from his waist to his feet.

decisions.choice: Joab son of Zeruiah: David's nephew
decisions.reason: Zeruiah was David's sister (1 Chronicles 2:16), and her sons Joab, Abishai and Asahel are always named after her. Joab had commanded David's army for most of his reign (2 Samuel 8:16).

decisions.choice: murdered; when there was no war, as if they were enemies in battle
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase "put blood of war in peace" in plain words.

decisions.choice: "derramó sangre de guerra en [tiempo de] paz"
decisions.reason: Spanish needs a verb and a noun for the Hebrew "put ... in peace"; Literal marks "tiempo de" as supplied. "Jeter" is the Spanish form of Jether, Amasa's father.

decisions.choice: Amasa fils de Yéther
decisions.reason: The father's name in its French form as this verse spells it; 2 Samuel 17:25 spells it Yitra.

decisions.choice: David speaks of Joab as "hắn"
decisions.reason: David condemns Joab as a murderer (meaning decision); Vietnamese "hắn" carries that judgment, as for Goliath and Doeg in Samuel.

decisions.choice: Abner, filho de Ner; Amasa, filho de Jéter
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the names as 1 and 2 Samuel have them in Portuguese (m1, m5). Amasa's father is "Jéter" here, as the Hebrew of this verse names him, with the accent Portuguese needs for its stress; 2 Samuel 17:25 in Portuguese calls him "Itra", the form that verse has.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ כְּחָכְמָתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹֽא־תוֹרֵ֧ד שֵׂיבָת֛וֹ בְּשָׁלֹ֖ם שְׁאֹֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And act according to your wisdom, and not bring down his gray head in peace [to] Sheol.

en.L: So act according to your wisdom, and do not bring down his gray head in peace [to] Sheol.
en.B: Act as your wisdom tells you, but do not allow his gray head to go down in peace to Sheol.
en.R: Be wise in the way you deal with him. Do not let him live out his old age and go down to the grave in peace.

es.L: Haz, pues, conforme a tu sabiduría, y no dejes descender sus canas en paz al Seol.
es.B: Actúa según tu sabiduría, pero no permitas que sus canas bajen en paz al lugar de los muertos.
es.R: Sé sabio en la manera de tratarlo. No dejes que llegue tranquilo a la vejez y baje en paz a la tumba.

fr.L: Et agis selon ta sagesse, et ne laisse pas descendre ses cheveux blancs en paix au Shéol.
fr.B: Agis selon ta sagesse, mais ne laisse pas ses cheveux blancs descendre en paix au séjour des morts.
fr.R: Sois sage dans ta façon de le traiter. Ne le laisse pas finir sa vieillesse et descendre en paix au séjour des morts.

sw.L: Basi utende kwa kadiri ya hekima yako, wala usiache mvi zake zishuke Kuzimu kwa amani.
sw.B: Tenda kama hekima yako inavyokuongoza, lakini usiache mvi zake zishuke Kuzimu kwa amani.
sw.R: Uwe na hekima katika jinsi utakavyomshughulikia. Usimwache aishi mpaka uzee wake na kushuka kaburini kwa amani.

vi.L: Vậy con hãy hành động theo sự khôn ngoan của con, đừng để mái đầu bạc của hắn xuống Âm Phủ trong bình an.
vi.B: Con hãy hành động theo sự khôn ngoan của con, nhưng đừng để mái đầu bạc của hắn được xuống Âm Phủ trong bình an.
vi.R: Hãy khôn ngoan mà xử trí hắn. Đừng để hắn sống yên đến tuổi già rồi bình an đi xuống nơi của người chết.

ko.L: 그러니 네 지혜대로 행하여, 그의 백발이 평안히 스올로 내려가게 하지 마라.
ko.B: 그러니 네 지혜대로 처리하여, 그의 백발이 평안히 스올로 내려가지 못하게 하여라.
ko.R: 그러니 그를 지혜롭게 다루어라. 그가 늙도록 살다가 평안히 무덤에 내려가게 하지 마라.

pt.L: Age, pois, segundo a tua sabedoria, e não faças descer os seus cabelos brancos em paz ao Sheol.
pt.B: Age como a tua sabedoria te mostrar, mas não deixes que os seus cabelos brancos desçam em paz ao mundo dos mortos.
pt.R: Sê sábio no modo de tratar com ele. Não deixes que ele chegue ao fim da velhice e desça em paz ao mundo dos mortos.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the realm of the dead, pictured as below the earth, where everyone goes at death (Genesis 37:35; 1 Samuel 2:6). To go down to Sheol is simply to die.

decisions.choice: bring down his gray head in peace: let him die of old age
decisions.reason: The gray head stands for an old man (Genesis 42:38; 44:29). To go down to Sheol in peace is to die a quiet, natural death. Joab was by now old, and David asks that he not be left to die that way.

decisions.choice: act according to your wisdom: deal with the blood guilt
decisions.reason: Innocent blood left unpunished brought guilt on the land and on those responsible for justice (Numbers 35:33; Deuteronomy 19:11-13). David had cursed Joab's house for Abner's death but never punished him (2 Samuel 3:28-39). Solomon is to judge how and when to act; verses 31-33 show that he sees Joab's death as removing that guilt from David's house.

decisions.choice: wisdom: skill in judging and acting
decisions.reason: Wisdom here is practical: knowing what to do in a hard case. It is the gift Solomon will ask for (3:9) and use in judgment (3:28).

decisions.choice: the grave
decisions.reason: Readable says "the grave" for Sheol, the place of the dead, as elsewhere at that level.

decisions.choice: "el Seol" (L); "el lugar de los muertos" (B); "la tumba" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol follows the Spanish of 1 Samuel and the Pentateuch terms list: Literal keeps the name, Balanced says what it is, Readable says "la tumba" as the English says "the grave" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: le Shéol (L); le séjour des morts (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol as in the French Pentateuch and Psalms: the name at Literal and "le séjour des morts" at Balanced and Readable, which already says plainly where the dead go; the English Readable says "the grave".

decisions.choice: Kuzimu
decisions.reason: Sheol is "Kuzimu" as in the Swahili of Psalms; Readable says "kaburini" (to the grave), as the English Readable says "the grave".

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalms note's words for Sheol, the place of the dead, which the earlier Vietnamese books use.

decisions.choice: "스올" (L, B); "무덤" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalms note keeps 스올 at Literal and Balanced; Readable follows the English Readable's "the grave" here, because the gray head going down is a picture of an old man's burial.

decisions.choice: os seus cabelos brancos; o Sheol (L); o mundo dos mortos (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Cabelos brancos" for the gray head (m2) is the phrase of Genesis 42:38 in Portuguese. Sheol (m1) is "o Sheol" at Literal and "o mundo dos mortos" at Balanced and Readable, as the Old Testament terms set it, where the English Readable says "the grave"; the same in verse 9.

source.text: וְלִבְנֵ֨י בַרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־חֶ֔סֶד וְהָי֖וּ בְּאֹכְלֵ֣י שֻׁלְחָנֶ֑ךָ כִּי־כֵן֙ קָרְב֣וּ אֵלַ֔י בְּבָרְחִ֕י מִפְּנֵ֖י אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם אָחִֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: But to [the] sons of Barzillai the Gileadite you shall do steadfast love, and they shall be among [those] eating [at] your table, for so they drew near to me when I fled from before Absalom your brother.

en.L: But to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite show steadfast love, and let them be among those eating [at] your table, for so they drew near to me when I fled from before Absalom your brother.
en.B: But show faithful love to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite; give them a place among those who eat at your table, for they came to my side in just that way when I was fleeing from your brother Absalom.
en.R: But show faithful love to the sons of Barzillai from Gilead. Let them be among the people who eat at your table. They stood by me in the same way when I was running away from your brother Absalom.

es.L: Pero a los hijos de Barzilai el galaadita harás amor leal, y estén entre los que comen [a] tu mesa, porque así se acercaron a mí cuando huía de delante de Absalón tu hermano.
es.B: Pero muestra amor fiel a los hijos de Barzilai el galaadita; dales un lugar entre los que comen a tu mesa, porque así se pusieron de mi lado cuando yo huía de tu hermano Absalón.
es.R: Pero muestra amor fiel a los hijos de Barzilai, el de Galaad. Que estén entre los que comen a tu mesa. Ellos me apoyaron de la misma manera cuando yo huía de tu hermano Absalón.

fr.L: Mais aux fils de Barzillaï le Galaadite, tu montreras de l’amour loyal, et ils seront parmi ceux qui mangent [à] ta table, car c’est ainsi qu’ils se sont approchés de moi quand je fuyais devant Absalom ton frère.
fr.B: Mais montre un amour fidèle envers les fils de Barzillaï le Galaadite : qu’ils soient parmi ceux qui mangent à ta table, car c’est ainsi qu’ils sont venus à mes côtés quand je fuyais devant ton frère Absalom.
fr.R: Mais montre un amour fidèle aux fils de Barzillaï, l’homme de Galaad. Qu’ils soient parmi ceux qui mangent à ta table. Ils m’ont soutenu de la même façon quand je fuyais devant ton frère Absalom.

sw.L: Lakini wana wa Barzilai Mgileadi uwatendee upendo usiokoma, nao wawe miongoni mwa wanaokula mezani pako, kwa maana ndivyo walivyonikaribia nilipomkimbia Absalomu ndugu yako.
sw.B: Lakini uwaonyeshe fadhili wana wa Barzilai Mgileadi; uwape nafasi miongoni mwa wale wanaokula mezani pako, kwa maana walikuja upande wangu vivyo hivyo nilipokuwa nikimkimbia ndugu yako Absalomu.
sw.R: Lakini uwaonyeshe fadhili wana wa Barzilai wa Gileadi. Waache wawe miongoni mwa watu wanaokula mezani pako. Wao walinisaidia vivyo hivyo nilipokuwa nikimkimbia ndugu yako Absalomu.

vi.L: Còn đối với các con trai của Bát-xi-lai người Ga-la-át, con hãy tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín, và cho họ ở trong số những người ăn [tại] bàn con; vì họ đã đến gần cha như vậy khi cha chạy trốn khỏi Áp-sa-lôm anh con.
vi.B: Nhưng con hãy tỏ lòng nhân từ với các con trai của Bát-xi-lai người Ga-la-át; hãy cho họ được ở trong số những người ăn chung bàn với con, vì họ đã đến bên cha như vậy khi cha chạy trốn Áp-sa-lôm, anh con.
vi.R: Nhưng con hãy tỏ lòng nhân từ với các con trai của Bát-xi-lai, người Ga-la-át. Hãy cho họ ăn chung bàn với con. Họ đã đứng về phía cha như vậy khi cha phải chạy trốn Áp-sa-lôm, anh con.

ko.L: 그러나 길르앗 사람 바르실래의 아들들에게는 한결같은 사랑을 베풀어, 그들이 네 상에서 먹는 사람들 가운데 있게 하여라. 내가 네 형 압살롬 앞에서 도망할 때 그들이 그렇게 내게 가까이 왔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 길르앗 사람 바르실래의 아들들에게는 인애를 베풀어, 네 식탁에서 먹는 사람들 가운데 있게 하여라. 내가 네 형 압살롬을 피해 도망할 때 그들이 그렇게 내 곁에 와 주었다.
ko.R: 그러나 길르앗 출신 바르실래의 아들들에게는 인애를 베풀어라. 그들이 네 식탁에서 함께 먹게 하여라. 내가 네 형 압살롬을 피해 도망할 때 그들이 그렇게 내 곁을 지켜 주었다.

pt.L: Mas com os filhos de Barzilai, o gileadita, usarás de lealdade, e eles estarão entre os que comem [à] tua mesa, pois assim eles se aproximaram de mim quando eu fugia de diante de Absalão, o teu irmão.
pt.B: Mas trata com lealdade os filhos de Barzilai, o gileadita, e dá-lhes um lugar entre os que comem à tua mesa, pois foi assim que eles vieram ficar do meu lado quando eu fugia do teu irmão Absalão.
pt.R: Mas mostra bondade leal aos filhos de Barzilai, de Gileade. Que eles estejam entre as pessoas que comem à tua mesa. Eles ficaram do meu lado do mesmo modo quando eu estava fugindo do teu irmão Absalão.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal kindness that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word names the loyal goodness that people bound to each other show, especially when it is not owed by law. Barzillai's family showed it to David, and David asks Solomon to return it.

decisions.choice: Barzillai: the old man who fed David at Mahanaim
decisions.reason: When David fled from Absalom, Barzillai of Rogelim in Gilead brought food and supplies to his army (2 Samuel 17:27-29). David offered to keep him in Jerusalem; he declined because of his age and sent Chimham in his place (2 Samuel 19:32-41).

decisions.choice: among those eating at your table: a place among the king's honored dependents
decisions.reason: To eat at the king's table was to be provided for by the king and given a place of honor at court, as David did for Mephibosheth (2 Samuel 9:7-13) and offered to Barzillai (2 Samuel 19:34).

decisions.choice: for so they drew near to me: their kindness came first
decisions.reason: "So" points back to what Solomon is to do: they came to David with the same kind of help when he needed it. Solomon's kindness repays theirs.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "faithful love", as everywhere this word is rendered at those levels.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: ḥesed follows the Samuel terms note, also between people: "amor leal" at Literal, "amor fiel" at Balanced and Readable (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: amour loyal (L); amour fidèle (B, R)
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* as settled in the French Samuel, between people as toward God.

decisions.choice: upendo usiokoma (Literal); fadhili (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* between people, as settled for Swahili in the Samuel note: "upendo usiokoma" at Literal, "fadhili" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L); "lòng nhân từ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: *ḥesed* between people, in the forms the Vietnamese Samuel drafts use.

decisions.choice: "Áp-sa-lôm anh con"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say which brother is older; Absalom was born long before Solomon.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L); "인애" (B, R) for *ḥesed* between people
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for *ḥesed* shown between people.

decisions.choice: "네 형 압살롬"
decisions.reason: Absalom was born before Solomon (2 Samuel 3:3; 5:14), so Korean calls him Solomon's older brother.

decisions.choice: Barzilai, o gileadita; lealdade (L, B); bondade leal (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 2 Samuel 9:1 and 16:17 set it in Portuguese: ḥesed between people (m1) is "lealdade" at Literal and Balanced and "bondade leal" at Readable, where the English says "faithful love"; "amor leal" is kept for the LORD's. "Barzilai, o gileadita" as 2 Samuel 19:32 in Portuguese (m2).

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֣ה עִ֠מְּךָ שִֽׁמְעִ֨י בֶן־גֵּרָ֥א בֶן־הַיְמִינִי֮ מִבַּחֻרִים֒ וְה֤וּא קִֽלְלַ֨נִי֙ קְלָלָ֣ה נִמְרֶ֔צֶת בְּי֖וֹם לֶכְתִּ֣י מַחֲנָ֑יִם וְהֽוּא־יָרַ֤ד לִקְרָאתִי֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וָאֶשָּׁ֨בַֽע ל֤וֹ בַֽיהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אִם־אֲמִֽיתְךָ֖ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, with you [is] Shimei son of Gera the Benjaminite from Bahurim, and he cursed me [with a] grievous curse on [the] day of my going [to] Mahanaim; and he came down to meet me [at] the Jordan, and I swore to him by Yahweh, saying, If I put you to death with the sword.

en.L: And look, with you [is] Shimei son of Gera, the Benjaminite from Bahurim. He cursed me with a grievous curse on the day I went [to] Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me [at] the Jordan, and I swore to him by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying, 'I will not put you to death with the sword.'
en.B: There is also Shimei son of Gera with you, the Benjaminite from Bahurim. He hurled bitter curses at me on the day I set out for Mahanaim. But he came down to the Jordan to meet me, and I gave him my oath by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: 'I will not put you to death with the sword.'
en.R: Shimei son of Gera is also still here with you. He is the man from the tribe of Benjamin who comes from Bahurim. He shouted terrible curses at me on the day I went to Mahanaim. Later he came down to the Jordan River to meet me, and I made a promise to him in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I said, 'I will not kill you with the sword.'

es.L: Y he aquí, contigo [está] Simei hijo de Gera, el benjamita de Bahurim. Él me maldijo con una maldición dolorosa el día que iba a Mahanaim; pero descendió a recibirme al Jordán, y yo le juré por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diciendo: ‘No te mataré a espada’.
es.B: También tienes contigo a Simei hijo de Gera, el benjamita de Bahurim. Él me lanzó terribles maldiciones el día que yo iba a Mahanaim. Pero después bajó al Jordán a recibirme, y yo le juré por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: ‘No te mataré a espada’.
es.R: Simei hijo de Gera también sigue aquí contigo. Es el hombre de la tribu de Benjamín que vive en Bahurim. Me gritó maldiciones terribles el día que me fui a Mahanaim. Más tarde bajó al río Jordán a recibirme, y yo le hice una promesa en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Le dije: ‘No te mataré a espada’.

fr.L: Et voici, avec toi [il y a] Shiméï fils de Guéra, le Benjaminite de Bahourim ; il m’a maudit d’une malédiction violente le jour où j’allais à Mahanaïm ; mais il est descendu à ma rencontre au Jourdain, et je lui ai juré par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, disant : “Je ne te ferai pas mourir par l’épée.”
fr.B: Il y a aussi auprès de toi Shiméï, fils de Guéra, le Benjaminite de Bahourim. Il m’a lancé des malédictions amères le jour où je partais pour Mahanaïm. Mais il est descendu au Jourdain à ma rencontre, et je lui ai juré par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Je ne te ferai pas mourir par l’épée.”
fr.R: Il y a aussi Shiméï, le fils de Guéra, qui est encore ici avec toi. C’est l’homme de la tribu de Benjamin qui vient de Bahourim. Il m’a crié de terribles malédictions le jour où je suis allé à Mahanaïm. Plus tard, il est descendu jusqu’au fleuve du Jourdain pour venir à ma rencontre, et je lui ai fait une promesse au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Je lui ai dit : “Je ne te tuerai pas par l’épée.”

sw.L: Na tazama, yuko pamoja nawe Shimei mwana wa Gera, Mbenyamini wa Bahurimu. Yeye alinilaani laana kali siku ile nilipokwenda Mahanaimu; lakini alishuka kunilaki [huko] Yordani, nami nikamwapia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nikisema, 'Sitakuua kwa upanga.'
sw.B: Tena yuko pamoja nawe Shimei mwana wa Gera, Mbenyamini wa Bahurimu. Alinitupia laana chungu siku nilipokwenda Mahanaimu. Lakini alishuka mpaka Yordani kunilaki, nami nikamwapia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: 'Sitakuua kwa upanga.'
sw.R: Shimei mwana wa Gera bado yuko hapa pamoja nawe. Yeye ni mtu wa kabila la Benyamini anayetoka Bahurimu. Alinipigia kelele za laana mbaya siku nilipokwenda Mahanaimu. Baadaye alishuka mpaka mto Yordani kunilaki, nami nikamwahidi kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nilisema, 'Sitakuua kwa upanga.'

vi.L: Kìa, bên con [còn có] Si-mê-i con trai Ghê-ra, người Bên-gia-min ở Ba-hu-rim. Hắn đã nguyền rủa cha một lời nguyền độc địa vào ngày cha đi [đến] Ma-ha-na-im; nhưng hắn đã xuống [sông] Giô-đanh đón cha, và cha đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề với hắn rằng: 'Ta sẽ không dùng gươm giết ngươi.'
vi.B: Bên con cũng còn có Si-mê-i con trai Ghê-ra, người Bên-gia-min ở Ba-hu-rim. Hắn đã nguyền rủa cha thậm tệ vào ngày cha đi đến Ma-ha-na-im. Nhưng hắn đã xuống sông Giô-đanh đón cha, và cha đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thề với hắn: 'Ta sẽ không dùng gươm giết ngươi.'
vi.R: Si-mê-i con trai Ghê-ra vẫn còn ở gần con. Hắn là người thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min, quê ở Ba-hu-rim. Hắn đã la lớn những lời nguyền rủa độc ác vào ngày cha đi đến Ma-ha-na-im. Sau đó hắn xuống sông Giô-đanh đón cha, và cha đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà hứa với hắn. Cha nói: 'Ta sẽ không dùng gươm giết ngươi.'

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 바후림 출신 베냐민 사람 게라의 아들 시므이가 너와 함께 있다. 그는 내가 마하나임으로 가던 날에 혹독한 저주로 나를 저주했다. 그러나 그가 요단으로 나를 맞으러 내려왔기에, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 그에게 '내가 너를 칼로 죽이지 않겠다' 하고 맹세했다.
ko.B: 또 바후림 출신 베냐민 사람 게라의 아들 시므이가 네 곁에 있다. 그는 내가 마하나임으로 가던 날에 나를 모질게 저주했다. 그러나 그가 요단강으로 나를 맞으러 내려왔을 때, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 '내가 너를 칼로 죽이지 않겠다' 하고 그에게 맹세했다.
ko.R: 게라의 아들 시므이도 아직 너와 함께 여기 있다. 그는 바후림 출신으로 베냐민 지파 사람이다. 그는 내가 마하나임으로 가던 날에 나에게 끔찍한 저주를 퍼부었다. 나중에 그가 요단강으로 나를 맞으러 내려왔을 때, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그에게 약속했다. '내가 너를 칼로 죽이지 않겠다' 하고 말이다.

pt.L: E eis que [está] contigo Simei, filho de Gera, o benjamita de Baurim. Ele me amaldiçoou com uma maldição terrível no dia em que eu fui a Maanaim; mas ele desceu ao meu encontro no Jordão, e eu lhe jurei {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, dizendo: 'Não matarei você à espada.'
pt.B: Também está contigo Simei, filho de Gera, o benjamita de Baurim. Ele lançou contra mim maldições amargas no dia em que eu ia para Maanaim. Mas ele desceu ao Jordão para me encontrar, e eu lhe fiz um juramento {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}: 'Não matarei você à espada.'
pt.R: Simei, filho de Gera, também ainda está aqui contigo. Ele é o homem da tribo de Benjamim que vem de Baurim. Ele gritou maldições terríveis contra mim no dia em que eu fui para Maanaim. Depois ele desceu ao rio Jordão para me encontrar, e eu lhe fiz uma promessa em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eu disse: 'Não vou matar você à espada.'

decisions.choice: Shimei's curse and David's oath
decisions.reason: As David fled from Absalom, Shimei of Saul's clan threw stones at him and cursed him as a man of blood (2 Samuel 16:5-13). When David returned, Shimei hurried down to the Jordan to beg forgiveness, and David swore that he would not die (2 Samuel 19:17-24).

decisions.choice: grievous: bitter, painful
decisions.reason: The word means severe or painful (Micah 2:10; Job 6:25). Shimei's curse was a deep insult, and cursing the ruler of God's people was forbidden (Exodus 22:27).

decisions.choice: if I put you to death: an oath meaning "I will not"
decisions.reason: A Hebrew oath often begins "if I do this..." and leaves the self-curse unsaid; the sense is a firm promise not to do it.

decisions.choice: with you: near you, within your reach
decisions.reason: Shimei is still alive and close at hand. Bahurim was a village east of Jerusalem on the road to the Jordan (2 Samuel 16:5).

decisions.choice: the man from the tribe of Benjamin; the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Benjaminite" and adds that the Jordan is a river.

decisions.choice: Simei, filho de Gera, o benjamita de Baurim; amaldiçoou; Maanaim
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the man, his tribe and his village keep the Portuguese of 2 Samuel 16:5 and 19:17, and "amaldiçoar" the word for his cursing there (m1, m2), so that the reader can follow the story from the curse to the oath and to verses 36-46. "Maanaim" as 2 Samuel 2:8. The oath David quotes keeps the "você" of 2 Samuel 19:24 in Portuguese.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־תְּנַקֵּ֔הוּ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ חָכָ֖ם אָ֑תָּה וְיָֽדַעְתָּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לּ֔וֹ וְהוֹרַדְתָּ֧ אֶת־שֵׂיבָת֛וֹ בְּדָ֖ם שְׁאֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: But now do not hold him innocent, for a wise man [are] you, and you will know what you shall do to him, and you shall bring down his gray head with blood [to] Sheol.

en.L: But now do not hold him innocent, for you [are] a wise man, and you will know what you should do to him, and you will bring down his gray head with blood [to] Sheol."
en.B: But now, do not treat him as innocent. You are a wise man; you will know what to do to him. Bring his gray head down to Sheol in blood."
en.R: But do not let him go unpunished. You are wise, and you will know what to do with him. He is an old man now, but see that he dies a violent death and goes down to the grave."

es.L: Pero ahora no lo tengas por inocente, porque [eres] hombre sabio, y sabrás lo que debes hacerle, y harás descender sus canas con sangre al Seol».
es.B: Pero ahora no lo trates como inocente. Eres un hombre sabio; sabrás qué hacer con él. Haz que sus canas bajen con sangre al lugar de los muertos».
es.R: Pero no lo dejes sin castigo. Eres sabio, y sabrás qué hacer con él. Ahora es un hombre viejo, pero procura que muera de muerte violenta y baje a la tumba».

fr.L: Mais maintenant, ne le tiens pas pour innocent, car tu [es] un homme sage, et tu sauras ce que tu dois lui faire, et tu feras descendre ses cheveux blancs dans le sang au Shéol. »
fr.B: Mais maintenant, ne le traite pas comme un innocent. Tu es un homme sage, tu sauras ce que tu dois lui faire. Fais descendre ses cheveux blancs dans le sang au séjour des morts. »
fr.R: Mais ne le laisse pas impuni. Tu es sage, et tu sauras quoi faire de lui. C’est un vieil homme maintenant, mais fais en sorte qu’il meure d’une mort violente et qu’il descende au séjour des morts. »

sw.L: Lakini sasa usimhesabu kuwa hana hatia, kwa maana wewe [ni] mtu mwenye hekima, nawe utajua unalopaswa kumtendea, nawe utazishusha mvi zake Kuzimu kwa damu."
sw.B: Lakini sasa usimchukulie kuwa hana hatia. Wewe ni mtu mwenye hekima; utajua la kumtendea. Zishushe mvi zake Kuzimu kwa damu."
sw.R: Lakini usimwache bila adhabu. Wewe una hekima, nawe utajua la kumfanyia. Sasa yeye ni mzee, lakini hakikisha kwamba anakufa kifo cha upanga na kushuka kaburini."

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ con đừng coi hắn là vô tội, vì con là người khôn ngoan, con sẽ biết điều con phải làm cho hắn; con sẽ đem mái đầu bạc của hắn xuống Âm Phủ trong máu."
vi.B: Nhưng bây giờ, con đừng xem hắn là vô tội. Con là người khôn ngoan; con sẽ biết phải xử hắn thế nào. Hãy để mái đầu bạc của hắn xuống Âm Phủ trong máu."
vi.R: Nhưng đừng để hắn thoát tội. Con khôn ngoan, con sẽ biết phải xử hắn thế nào. Bây giờ hắn đã già, nhưng con hãy lo cho hắn phải chết cách đau đớn mà đi xuống nơi của người chết."

ko.L: 그러나 이제 그를 죄 없는 사람으로 여기지 마라. 너는 지혜로운 사람이니, 그에게 무엇을 해야 할지 알 것이다. 너는 그의 백발이 피 흘리며 스올로 내려가게 하여라."
ko.B: 그러나 이제 너는 그를 죄 없는 사람으로 여기지 마라. 너는 지혜로운 사람이니 그를 어떻게 해야 할지 알 것이다. 그의 백발이 피를 흘리며 스올로 내려가게 하여라."
ko.R: 그러나 그가 벌을 받지 않고 지나가게 하지는 마라. 너는 지혜로우니 그를 어떻게 해야 할지 알 것이다. 그는 이제 늙었지만, 그가 평안히 죽지 못하고 피를 흘리며 무덤에 내려가게 하여라."

pt.L: Mas agora não o tenhas por inocente, pois tu [és] um homem sábio, e saberás o que lhe deves fazer, e farás descer os seus cabelos brancos com sangue ao Sheol."
pt.B: Agora, porém, não o trates como inocente. Tu és um homem sábio e saberás o que fazer com ele. Faz descer com sangue ao mundo dos mortos os seus cabelos brancos."
pt.R: Mas não o deixes sem castigo. És sábio e saberás o que fazer com ele. Ele já é velho, mas cuida para que tenha uma morte violenta e desça ao mundo dos mortos."

decisions.choice: do not hold him innocent: do not let him go unpunished
decisions.reason: The verb means to treat someone as free of guilt, and so to leave him unpunished (Exodus 20:7; 34:7).

decisions.choice: but now: David's oath does not cancel Shimei's guilt
decisions.reason: David's oath bound David himself (verse 8). He now leaves Shimei's case to Solomon's judgment. The narrator does not comment on whether this was right; verses 36-46 show Solomon giving Shimei terms he could keep and acting only when he broke them.

decisions.choice: bring down his gray head with blood to Sheol: let him die a violent death
decisions.reason: The words answer verse 6 and contrast with "in peace" there: the old man is not to die a quiet death but to be put to death for his crime.

decisions.choice: He is an old man now, but see that he dies a violent death
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the gray head brought down with blood.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב דָּוִ֖ד עִם־אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down David with his fathers, and he was buried in [the] city of David.

en.L: And David lay down with his fathers, and he was buried in the City of David.
en.B: Then David rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David.
en.R: Then David died and was buried in the City of David.

es.L: Y durmió David con sus padres, y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David.
es.B: Luego David descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David.
es.R: Luego David murió y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David.

fr.L: Et David se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré dans la cité de David.
fr.B: Puis David reposa avec ses ancêtres, et il fut enterré dans la cité de David.
fr.R: Puis David est mort, et il a été enterré dans la cité de David.

sw.L: Daudi akalala pamoja na baba zake, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi.
sw.B: Kisha Daudi akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi.
sw.R: Kisha Daudi akafa, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi.

vi.L: Đa-vít nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít.
vi.B: Rồi Đa-vít an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít.
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít qua đời và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 다윗은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 다윗은 죽었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다.

pt.L: E Davi descansou com os seus pais e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi.
pt.B: Então Davi descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi.
pt.R: Então Davi morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados. Ele foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: This is the formula Kings uses for the death of a king (11:43; 14:20, 31). It speaks of death as lying down to rest and joining those who went before.

decisions.choice: the City of David: the old stronghold of Zion in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: David captured the stronghold of Zion from the Jebusites and named it the City of David (2 Samuel 5:7, 9). It was the oldest part of Jerusalem, on the hill south of the later temple, and the kings of Judah were buried there (11:43; 14:31).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: "durmió con sus padres" (L); "descansó con sus antepasados" (B); "murió" (R); "fue sepultado en la ciudad de David"
decisions.reason: The burial formula of Kings and Chronicles keeps one wording at each level, as the Kings terms note sets for Spanish (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "조상들과 함께 누웠고" (L), "조상들과 함께 잠들었고" (B), "죽었고" (R); "다윗 성에 묻혔다"
decisions.reason: The death and burial formula of the Kings and Chronicles terms note, one wording per level through Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais (L); descansou com os seus antepassados (B); morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados (R); foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi
alternatives: se deitou com os seus pais (L)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, the death formula of the kings (m1) is worded the same way every time: "descansou com os seus pais" at Literal and "descansou com os seus antepassados" at Balanced, as 2 Samuel 7:12 has "descansares com os teus antepassados" at Balanced; Readable says plainly that he died, as the English does, and keeps "descansar com os seus antepassados" so the formula can still be recognised. Literal says "descansou" rather than "se deitou", which in Portuguese reads as going to bed. "Cidade de Davi" keeps its capital, as 2 Samuel 5:7 (m2).

source.text: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָלַ֤ךְ דָּוִד֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּחֶבְר֤וֹן מָלַךְ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם מָלַ֔ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֹ֖שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And the days which reigned David over Israel [were] forty years; in Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

en.L: And the days that David reigned over Israel [were] forty years: in Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
en.B: David's reign over Israel lasted forty years: seven of them he reigned in Hebron, and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
en.R: David was king over Israel for forty years. He ruled in Hebron for seven years and in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

es.L: Y los días que reinó David sobre Israel [fueron] cuarenta años: en Hebrón reinó siete años, y en Jerusalén reinó treinta y tres años.
es.B: El reinado de David sobre Israel duró cuarenta años: siete de ellos reinó en Hebrón, y treinta y tres en Jerusalén.
es.R: David fue rey de Israel durante cuarenta años. Gobernó en Hebrón siete años y en Jerusalén treinta y tres años.

fr.L: Et les jours que David régna sur Israël [furent] de quarante ans : à Hébron il régna sept ans, et à Jérusalem il régna trente-trois ans.
fr.B: Le règne de David sur Israël dura quarante ans : il régna sept ans à Hébron, et trente-trois ans à Jérusalem.
fr.R: David a été roi d’Israël pendant quarante ans. Il a régné à Hébron pendant sept ans, et à Jérusalem pendant trente-trois ans.

sw.L: Na siku ambazo Daudi alitawala juu ya Israeli [zilikuwa] miaka arobaini: huko Hebroni alitawala miaka saba, na huko Yerusalemu alitawala miaka thelathini na mitatu.
sw.B: Utawala wa Daudi juu ya Israeli ulidumu miaka arobaini: miaka saba alitawala huko Hebroni, na thelathini na mitatu huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Daudi alikuwa mfalme wa Israeli kwa miaka arobaini. Alitawala huko Hebroni kwa miaka saba na huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka thelathini na mitatu.

vi.L: Những ngày Đa-vít làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên [là] bốn mươi năm: ông làm vua tại Hếp-rôn bảy năm và làm vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba mươi ba năm.
vi.B: Đa-vít trị vì Y-sơ-ra-ên bốn mươi năm: bảy năm tại Hếp-rôn và ba mươi ba năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Đa-vít làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên bốn mươi năm. Ông cai trị tại Hếp-rôn bảy năm và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba mươi ba năm.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘을 다스린 날들은 사십 년이었다. 헤브론에서 칠 년을 다스렸고, 예루살렘에서 삼십삼 년을 다스렸다.
ko.B: 다윗이 이스라엘을 다스린 기간은 사십 년이었다. 헤브론에서 칠 년, 예루살렘에서 삼십삼 년을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 다윗은 사십 년 동안 이스라엘의 왕이었다. 그는 헤브론에서 칠 년, 예루살렘에서 삼십삼 년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: E os dias em que Davi reinou sobre Israel [foram] quarenta anos: em Hebrom reinou sete anos, e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos.
pt.B: O reinado de Davi sobre Israel durou quarenta anos: sete anos ele reinou em Hebrom, e trinta e três em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Davi foi rei de Israel durante quarenta anos. Ele governou em Hebrom durante sete anos e em Jerusalém durante trinta e três anos.

decisions.choice: forty years: a round total
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 5:4-5 gives seven years and six months in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem. The summary here rounds the Hebron years.

decisions.choice: over Israel: the whole reign
decisions.reason: In Hebron David reigned at first over Judah only (2 Samuel 2:4, 11). The summary counts his whole reign as his reign over Israel.

source.text: וּשְׁלֹמֹ֕ה יָשַׁ֕ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֖א דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַתִּכֹּ֥ן מַלְכֻת֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And Solomon sat on [the] throne of David his father, and was established his kingdom greatly.

en.L: And Solomon sat on the throne of David his father, and his kingdom was established greatly.
en.B: So Solomon took his seat on the throne of his father David, and his royal rule was made very firm.
en.R: Solomon now ruled as king in his father David's place, and his rule was very secure.

es.L: Y Salomón se sentó en el trono de David su padre, y su reino fue afirmado en gran manera.
es.B: Así Salomón ocupó el trono de su padre David, y su reinado quedó muy firme.
es.R: Ahora Salomón reinaba en lugar de su padre David, y su gobierno estaba muy seguro.

fr.L: Et Salomon s’assit sur le trône de David son père, et sa royauté fut affermie grandement.
fr.B: Salomon s’assit donc sur le trône de son père David, et sa royauté fut solidement affermie.
fr.R: Salomon régnait maintenant comme roi à la place de son père David, et son pouvoir était bien établi.

sw.L: Sulemani akaketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi baba yake, na ufalme wake ukathibitika sana.
sw.B: Basi Sulemani akaketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha baba yake Daudi, na utawala wake ukaimarishwa sana.
sw.R: Sasa Sulemani akatawala kama mfalme mahali pa baba yake Daudi, na utawala wake ukawa imara sana.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn ngồi trên ngai của Đa-vít cha mình, và vương quyền của người được vững lập rất mạnh.
vi.B: Vậy Sa-lô-môn lên ngồi trên ngai của Đa-vít cha mình, và vương quyền của vua được củng cố vững vàng.
vi.R: Bây giờ Sa-lô-môn làm vua thay cho Đa-vít cha mình, và quyền cai trị của vua rất vững chắc.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 자기 아버지 다윗의 왕좌에 앉았고, 그의 나라가 크게 굳게 섰다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 아버지 다윗의 왕좌에 앉았고, 그의 왕권은 매우 튼튼해졌다.
ko.R: 이제 솔로몬이 아버지 다윗을 이어 왕으로 다스렸다. 그의 왕권은 아주 든든했다.

pt.L: E Salomão se sentou no trono de Davi, o seu pai, e o seu reino foi estabelecido grandemente.
pt.B: Assim Salomão ocupou o trono do seu pai Davi, e o seu reinado ficou muito firme.
pt.R: Agora Salomão governava como rei no lugar do seu pai Davi, e o seu governo estava bem seguro.

decisions.choice: sat on the throne: reigned
decisions.reason: To sit on the throne is to rule as king (1:13, 17).

decisions.choice: his kingdom was established: Yahweh's promise kept
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in Yahweh's promise to David, "I will establish his kingdom" (2 Samuel 7:12). The chapter ends with the same verb (verse 46): the story in between shows how Solomon's rule was made firm.

decisions.choice: kingdom: royal rule
decisions.reason: The word means kingship or reign, the king's power to rule, more than the land he rules.

decisions.choice: Solomon now ruled as king in his father David's place
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom of sitting on the throne.

decisions.choice: foi estabelecido (L); ficou firme (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of the LORD's promise, "I will establish his kingdom" (m2), so Literal and Balanced use the verbs of 2 Samuel 7:12 and 7:16 in Portuguese, "estabelecer" and "firmar"; verses 45 and 46 repeat them, closing the chapter's frame.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֞א אֲדֹנִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־חַגֵּ֗יתאֶל־בַּת־שֶׁ֨בַע֙ אֵם־שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַתֹּ֖אמֶר הֲשָׁל֣וֹם בֹּאֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Adonijah son of Haggith to Bathsheba mother of Solomon, and she said, [In] peace your coming? And he said, Peace.

en.L: And Adonijah son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, and she said, "[Is] your coming [in] peace?" And he said, "Peace."
en.B: Then Adonijah son of Haggith came to Bathsheba, Solomon's mother. She asked, "Have you come in peace?" "Yes, in peace," he answered.
en.R: Some time later Adonijah son of Haggith came to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother. She asked him, "Is this a friendly visit?" "Yes, it is," he answered.

es.L: Y vino Adonías hijo de Haguit a Betsabé, madre de Salomón, y ella dijo: «¿[Es] de paz tu venida?». Y él dijo: «De paz».
es.B: Después Adonías hijo de Haguit fue a ver a Betsabé, la madre de Salomón. Ella le preguntó: «¿Vienes en paz?». «Sí, en paz», respondió él.
es.R: Algún tiempo después, Adonías hijo de Haguit fue a ver a Betsabé, la madre de Salomón. Ella le preguntó: «¿Vienes como amigo?». «Sí», respondió él.

fr.L: Et Adonias fils de Haggith vint vers Bethsabée, mère de Salomon ; et elle dit : « [Est-ce en] paix [que tu] viens ? » Et il dit : « En paix. »
fr.B: Adonias, fils de Haggith, vint alors trouver Bethsabée, la mère de Salomon. Elle lui demanda : « Viens-tu en paix ? » « Oui, en paix », répondit-il.
fr.R: Quelque temps plus tard, Adonias, le fils de Haggith, est venu voir Bethsabée, la mère de Salomon. Elle lui a demandé : « Est-ce une visite amicale ? » « Oui », a-t-il répondu.

sw.L: Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi akaja kwa Bathsheba mama yake Sulemani, naye akasema, "Je, kuja kwako [ni kwa] amani?" Akasema, "Amani."
sw.B: Kisha Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi akaja kwa Bathsheba, mama yake Sulemani. Akamwuliza, "Je, umekuja kwa amani?" Akajibu, "Ndiyo, kwa amani."
sw.R: Baada ya muda Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi akaenda kumwona Bathsheba, mama yake Sulemani. Akamwuliza, "Je, umekuja kwa nia njema?" Akajibu, "Ndiyo."

vi.L: A-đô-ni-gia con trai Ha-ghít đến gặp Bát-sê-ba, mẹ của Sa-lô-môn. Bà nói: "Ông đến [trong] bình an chứ?" Ông đáp: "Bình an."
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-đô-ni-gia con trai Ha-ghít đến gặp Bát-sê-ba, mẹ của Sa-lô-môn. Bà hỏi: "Ông đến có bình an không?" Ông đáp: "Thưa, bình an."
vi.R: Ít lâu sau, A-đô-ni-gia con trai Ha-ghít đến thăm Bát-sê-ba, mẹ của Sa-lô-môn. Bà hỏi ông: "Ông đến đây với thiện ý chứ?" Ông trả lời: "Dạ, phải."

ko.L: 그리고 학깃의 아들 아도니야가 솔로몬의 어머니 밧세바에게 왔다. 그 여자가 "평안한 일로 왔소?" 하고 말하자, 그가 "평안한 일입니다" 하고 말했다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 학깃의 아들 아도니야가 솔로몬의 어머니 밧세바를 찾아왔다. 밧세바가 "좋은 일로 왔소?" 하고 묻자, 그가 "예, 좋은 일로 왔습니다" 하고 대답했다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 학깃의 아들 아도니야가 솔로몬의 어머니 밧세바를 만나러 왔다. 밧세바가 물었다. "좋은 뜻으로 찾아왔소?" 그가 대답했다. "예, 그렇습니다."

pt.L: E Adonias, filho de Hagite, veio a Bate-Seba, a mãe de Salomão, e ela disse: "[É] em paz a sua vinda?" E ele disse: "Em paz."
pt.B: Então Adonias, filho de Hagite, foi falar com Bate-Seba, mãe de Salomão. Ela perguntou: "Você vem em paz?" "Sim, em paz", respondeu ele.
pt.R: Algum tempo depois, Adonias, filho de Hagite, foi visitar Bate-Seba, a mãe de Salomão. Ela lhe perguntou: "Esta é uma visita de amigo?" "Sim, é", respondeu ele.

decisions.choice: Adonijah son of Haggith: Solomon's older half-brother and rival
decisions.reason: Adonijah was David's fourth son (2 Samuel 3:4) and the oldest still living. He had tried to make himself king while David was dying, and Solomon spared him on condition that he behave well (1:5-10, 50-53).

decisions.choice: in peace: with friendly intent
decisions.reason: To ask whether someone comes in peace is to ask whether he means well or brings trouble (1 Samuel 16:4-5; 2 Kings 9:17-22). Bathsheba has reason to be wary of the man who tried to take the throne from her son.

decisions.choice: Is this a friendly visit? Yes, it is
decisions.reason: Readable puts the question about peace in everyday words. "Some time later" marks the new scene, which the Hebrew begins with its usual "and".

decisions.choice: "¿Vienes en paz?" (B); "¿Vienes como amigo?" (R)
decisions.reason: The question follows the Samuel terms note at Balanced; Readable says what "in peace" means, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: Je, umekuja kwa amani?
decisions.reason: The question about *shalom* in the wording settled for Swahili in the Samuel note; Readable says "kwa nia njema" (with good intent), as the English Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: Bathsheba says "ông" to Adonijah; he says "bà" and "tôi"
decisions.reason: They are rivals' kin, not mother and son; both keep the polite forms of adults of rank, and Adonijah's "thưa" / "dạ" shows his deference.

decisions.choice: Bathsheba speaks to Adonijah in 하오체; he answers in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The king's mother speaks to the king's older half-brother with reserve but not as to a servant; he, asking a favor, speaks up to her.

decisions.choice: você (Bathsheba to Adonijah); a senhora (Adonijah to Bathsheba)
decisions.reason: Bathsheba speaks to Adonijah with "você"; he speaks to her, the king's mother, with "a senhora" (verses 14-17), as one speaks to a woman of higher rank whose favor one asks. Readable says what coming "in peace" means here (m2), as the English does.

source.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דָּבָ֥ר לִ֖י אֵלָ֑יִךְ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, A word [is] to me to you. And she said, Speak.

en.L: And he said, "I have a word for you." And she said, "Speak."
en.B: Then he said, "I have something to say to you." "Say it," she replied.
en.R: He said, "I want to ask you something." She said, "Go ahead."

es.L: Y dijo: «Tengo una palabra para ti». Y ella dijo: «Habla».
es.B: Entonces él dijo: «Tengo algo que decirte». «Dilo», respondió ella.
es.R: Él dijo: «Quiero pedirte algo». Ella dijo: «Adelante».

fr.L: Et il dit : « J’ai une parole pour toi. » Et elle dit : « Parle. »
fr.B: Puis il dit : « J’ai quelque chose à te dire. » « Parle », répondit-elle.
fr.R: Il a dit : « J’ai quelque chose à te demander. » Elle a répondu : « Vas-y. »

sw.L: Akasema, "Nina neno kwako." Akasema, "Sema."
sw.B: Kisha akasema, "Nina jambo la kukuambia." Akajibu, "Sema."
sw.R: Akasema, "Nataka kukuomba jambo." Akamwambia, "Endelea."

vi.L: Ông nói: "Tôi có một lời với bà." Bà nói: "Hãy nói đi."
vi.B: Rồi ông nói: "Tôi có chuyện muốn thưa với bà." Bà đáp: "Ông cứ nói."
